After this, you owe me a pay raise!|[[Executioner (Narrator)|Executioner]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[The Great Finale]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Executioner''', also referred to as '''Executioner Plush''', was the boss of the first act and a regular enemy in the third act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. It had much higher health than all enemies that appeared before it, but it was also significantly slower. The '''Executioner''' had one ability where it threw its axe at a random tower, stunning any tower hit by it. In the first act, it was a boss enemy, making it immune to being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], immune to freezing and could only be slowed down by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. It had none of these immunities in the third act. ==Appearance== The '''Executioner''' was a plushie version of the Level 5 {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} [[Executioner]]. It had a dark purple helmet with horns with blue glow inside of it, dark purple shoulder-pads, chestplate and leg padding. It had yellow button kneepads, a purple belt and a giant yellow button on its torso. It also wore purple gloves and shoes. The '''Executioner''' wielded a large grey and red axe which it used to attack towers. ==Strategy== *Multiple lower level DPS towers, like Level 2 [[Minigunner]]s, [[Golden Minigunner]]s or Level 2-3 [[Accelerator]]s can be very useful against the '''Executioner'''. **Multiple weaker towers, such as multiple Level 3-4 [[Golden Scout]]s, Level 3-4 [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Militant]]s can also be quite useful. **Towers that cannot be stunned by the '''Executioner's''' ability, like the [[Pursuit]], are particularly effective against it. *Placing down cheap towers as a distraction, such as a [[Scout]] or [[Golden Scout]], can be very helpful by distracting the '''Executioner's''' axe from hitting your offensive towers. **However, this may not be viable in [[The Great Finale]], due to limited space on this map. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:ExecutionerSwing.ogg]] |When the '''Executioner''' performs ''Head Chopping'' ability |- |[[File:AxeHit.ogg]] |When the '''Executioner''' performs ''Head Chopping'' ability |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ExecutionerWalk.gif|Walking animation (28 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) ExecutionerThrow.gif|''Head Chopping'' animation (28 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} File:Act 1 Scene 3|'''Executioner''' in the ending [[A Dark Tale]] cutscene. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Executioner's''' theme is a remix of the [[Swamp Monster]]'s theme. *Weirdly, in [[A Dark Tale]], the boss health bar of this enemy called it the ''Executioner Plush'', despite its actual name being ''Executioner''. **This is because the internal name of the '''Executioner''' is ''Executioner Plush''. **However in [[The Great Finale]] the [[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] calls the '''Executioner''' an actor. This makes it unclear if the '''Executioner''' is a plush or an actor. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]b **'''Executioner''' added. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]l **The '''Executioner''' now appears in [[The Great Finale]]. *'''12 November 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]]n **Health in [[The Great Finale]] increased from 5,000 to 7,000. *'''21 December 2023''' - [[v1.11.0]] **'''Executioner''' removed. ==Notes== {{ADarkTale|[[Cobalt Guard (Lunar Overture)|Cobalt Guard]]|Wave 13|Executioner|Wave 16|End|N/A}} {{TheGreatFinale|[[Marionette (Lunar Overture)|Marionette]]|Wave 9|Executioner|Wave 10|[[Sock Puppet (Lunar Overture)|Sock Puppet]]|Wave 11}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Executioner}}
